title: CanonicalLead
description: Canonical normalized representation of an incoming lead across all acquisition channels.

lead_id.description: Unique internal identifier for the lead within the automation pipeline.

source.description: The acquisition channel where the lead originated.

external_id.description: Platform-specific ID from the originating channel (e.g., Facebook leadgen_id, LINE userId).

contact.description: Contact information for the individual submitter.

name.description: Full name or display name of the contact.

phone.description: Contact phone number (international or national standard).

message.description: Raw unstructured enquiry or message content submitted by the customer.

received_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp indicating when the lead was received.

metadata.description: Optional channel-specific or tracking metadata (e.g., UTM parameters, page URL).
